content.text:
I can't read your Garmin data right now. The server's Garmin login is missing or has expired, and retrying won't fix that.

To fix it, the server's owner needs to make a new Personal API key in Garmin Connect and set it on the server. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll pull today's recovery, sleep, HRV and training status.

If you want to give me a quick description of how you feel, I can talk through it with you in the meantime. For example: how you slept, how your legs feel, and what you have planned today.
